material_coverage_findings.finding: The passenger/device/night penalties and underage-alcohol consequences are not fully represented by the accepted licensing facts.

proposed_statements.statement: A first graduated-license wireless-device violation carries a two-hundred-dollar fine and license points.
A seat-belt violation under the graduated restrictions carries a twenty-five-dollar fine.
A graduated-permit passenger restriction violation carries one point on the driving record.
A provisional-permit nighttime-driving violation carries one point on the driving record.
A first under-twenty-one zero-tolerance offense results in the court holding the permit or license for thirty days.
A driver younger than twenty-one with a BAC of at least 0.08 is subject to the same DWI laws as an adult driver.
